sections.heading: Introduction
content: Welcome to Guardians (hereafter Platform)
These Terms and Conditions govern your access to and use of the Platform. By registering, accessing, or using the Platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms.
If you do not agree to these Terms, please do not use the Platform.

sections.heading: Purpose of the Platform
content: The Platform is a pilot initiative designed to support volunteers, participants, and community groups in organizing, documenting, and coordinating activities that contribute to positive social and environmental impact.
The Platform is provided for community collaboration purposes only.

sections.heading: Eligibility
content: You must:

items: Comply with these Terms and all applicable laws.

trailingContent: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access for users who violate these Terms.

sections.heading: Volunteer Participation
content: Participation through the Platform is voluntary.
Nothing in these Terms creates:
trailingContent: between the Platform and any user.
Volunteers participate at their own discretion and responsibility.

sections.heading: User Responsibilities
content: Users agree to:

items: Use the Platform only for lawful and ethical purposes.
Protect the privacy and dignity of other participants.
Harass, bully, threaten, or discriminate against others.
Upload illegal, offensive, harmful, or misleading content.
Attempt unauthorized access to systems or accounts.
Use the Platform for commercial spam or unauthorized fundraising.

sections.heading: Safeguarding
content: The safety and wellbeing of participants is a priority.
All users must comply with the Platform's Safeguarding Policy and Code of Conduct.
Where safeguarding concerns arise, the Platform reserves the right to:

items: Notify relevant authorities where required by law.

content: Users retain ownership of content they submit.

trailingContent: for the purpose of operating and improving the Platform.

Users may not copy, distribute, or modify Platform materials without permission.

sections.heading: Pilot Status Disclaimer
content: The Platform is currently operated as a pilot project.
Users acknowledge that:

items: Data structures and processes may evolve.

trailingContent: The Platform is provided on an "as available" basis.
No guarantee is made regarding uninterrupted availability.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, the Platform and its operators shall not be liable for:

items: Personal decisions made based on Platform content;
Actions or omissions of other users.

trailingContent: Users participate in activities at their own risk.

sections.heading: Privacy and Data Protection
content: Personal data is processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
By using the Platform, you acknowledge that your information may be processed as described in the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Account Suspension and Termination
content: We may suspend or terminate access if:

items: Continued participation may harm the community or the Platform.

trailingContent: Users may stop using the Platform at any time.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
content: We may update these Terms periodically.
Updated versions will be published on the Platform.
Continued use after changes become effective constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

content: These Terms shall be governed by the laws of Hungary.
Any disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts of that country, unless otherwise required by applicable law.
